▤Upgrade blueprintownedPoint at something you built and click to take it up a tier: walls to stone and steel, doors to iron, turrets to Mk II and III, floors, gates, bars for windows. Each tier's blueprint is bought in the kiosk's Fortify tab; R picks which part of a wall (its door or window, or the wall itself). Places for $0.OWNED

▤Shovel blueprintownedLevels the cell you point at, and fills in any rabbit burrow in it, blending it into the ground around it. Rough or sloping ground refuses a build; this is how you fix it. Works on a cell that already has something standing in it. Places for $4.OWNED

▤Gate blueprintCuts a gate into a run of barbed wire, a barricade or a railing — point at it. E opens and shuts it like a door. Shut, it holds like the run it replaced; upgrade it to iron and steel. Places for $16.$60
▤Barricade blueprintownedCheap steel beams along a square’s edge. Slows and soaks. Goes on the ground, a deck, or along the top of a wall. Places for $8.OWNED
▤Wall blueprintSolid log wall along the edge of a square — R picks the edge, two in one square make a corner. Real stopping power. Places for $14.$25
▤Window blueprintCuts a firing window in a wall. Ground-level windows let smaller zombies climb inside: fit steel mesh in Fortify to stop them. Weakens the wall. Places for $10.$45

▤Door blueprintHangs a pair of doors in a wall — point at the wall. E opens and shuts them: shut, they are as solid as the wall; open, anything can walk through — so close them behind you. Weakens the wall more than a window does. Places for $14.$55
▤Sandbag wall blueprintLow, tough cover along a square’s edge, or heaped along the top of a wall. Cheap to line a lane with. Places for $10.$20

▤Platform blueprintSteel deck on the walls of its square — or bolted onto a wooden floor as a gun mount (one per floor). Its raised middle lifts a turret over the rail line, and all four edges can take a railing. Places for $22.$60

▤Floor blueprintWooden boards on the walls of its square, or bridging out from the wall of the square next door: a floor for the storey above and a roof for the one below. A platform can go on a floor; a floor never goes on a platform. Places for $26.$70

▤Structural pillar blueprintSteel post for the corner where four squares meet. On its own it holds up a floor or platform in each of those four squares; with a wall within three squares, in twelve. Its cap takes a turret. Places for $20.$50
▤Stairs blueprintTakes the whole cell and ramps up a storey. Anything that walks can use them — including the horde, so mind where you put them. Places for $30.$65

▤Barbed wire blueprintHalf height, so you shoot straight over it. Runs along a square’s edge like a wall: on the ground, a deck’s rim, or strung along the top of a wall, sandbags or a barricade (point at it). Cuts anything that comes through it, and comes apart quickly. Places for $9.$35
▤Railing blueprintLow rail for a deck edge: R picks the edge, and a deck can be railed on all four with a turret in the middle. Your rounds go between the bars. Places for $12.$40
▤Spike trap blueprintBuried spike bed. Springs once when something steps into its square: spikes through everything standing on it, then it is spent and the square is free again. Places for $12.$30
▤Fuel drum blueprintFuel drum. Shoot it when the pack is beside it; chains into its neighbours. Places for $18.$40
▤Land mine blueprintBuried charge. Goes off under the first thing that steps on it. Places for $14.$45
▤Decoy beacon blueprintFlashing, screaming beacon. The horde chases it instead of you for 20s, then it burns out. Places for $30.$70
▤Light turret blueprintAuto-turret. Cheap, chattery, fine vs. shamblers. Places for $24.$55
▤Flame turret blueprintShort-range fire cone. Crowds hate it. Places for $36.$75
▤Heavy turret blueprintSlow, hard-hitting sentry gun. Places for $45.$110
▤Mortar blueprintCrew-served tube. E to mount, LMB lobs a shell at the reticle (arc shown), T to shoulder it and carry it elsewhere. Shells sold under Ammo. Places for $60.$120
▤Watchman MG blueprintWatchman MG on a tripod. E to mount, LMB fires the belt, T to shoulder it. It will not fire unless you are on it. Comes with 500 of 1,000 rounds. Places for $80.$260

▤Shovel blueprintownedLevels the cell you point at, and fills in any rabbit burrow in it, blending it into the ground around it. Rough or sloping ground refuses a build; this is how you fix it. Works on a cell that already has something standing in it. Places for $4.OWNED

▤Land mine blueprintBuried charge. Goes off under the first thing that steps on it. Places for $14.$45

▤Flame turret blueprintShort-range fire cone. Crowds hate it. Places for $36.$75
▤Heavy turret blueprintSlow, hard-hitting sentry gun. Places for $45.$110
